findings.title: The live agent-event forwarder never authenticates, so a release VisionClaw refuses the socket before W2-01 is reached
findings.consequence: In release builds no agent action reaches the embodiment render through the forwarder, and the forwarder reconnects every 30 s indefinitely (agent-event-ws-subscriber.js:130-141). The dev stack compiles the escape hatch (VisionClaw:Cargo.toml:331-333 dev-runtime with debug-assertions; scripts/rust-backend-wrapper.sh:42 dev-auth), but no pinned compose or script sets ALLOW_INSECURE_DEFAULTS, and launch.sh:205 lists it as a forbidden setting. So the default dev stack also returns 401 unless the operator's .env sets it, which is not checkable from source. Fixing W2-01 alone would not make the edge work.

findings.title: W2-01 still holds at the pins, the rejection is silent, and agentbox's own test asserts the defective shape
findings.consequence: In dev builds that accept the socket, every frame is refused as malformed. The error reply has no type field, so agentbox discards it without logging, and its test would fail if the forwarder were fixed to send the canonical envelope.

findings.title: GET /v1/tasks strips three fields VisionClaw requires, so list_tasks always fails
findings.consequence: Every list_tasks call returns DeserializationError. Interrupting a task this orchestrator created still works through the local fast path (VisionClaw:src/actors/task_orchestrator_actor.rs:450-458). Interrupting by claude-flow agent id fails with a Transport error (:464-468), ListActiveTasks fails (:512-516), and the agent monitor logs an error each poll and publishes no agent list (VisionClaw:src/actors/agent_monitor_actor.rs:403-425). The VisionClaw test passes because its fake API serves fields the real producer strips.

findings.title: GET /v1/tasks/:taskId strips taskDir and logFile, which TaskStatus requires
findings.consequence: Task status polling from VisionClaw fails for every task.

findings.title: Kind 31402 priority is a label on every producer and an integer on the relay
findings.consequence: Every broker case projects at priority 50, so declared critical and high cases rank no higher than low ones wherever broker_cases.priority is used.

findings.title: The agentbox governance-bridge writes 31402 events without the tags the relay projects
findings.consequence: If the outbox event is published as written, the case appears as Untitled, manual_submission, priority 50. The outbox drain was not traced.

findings.title: visionclaw-wire says every producer encoder is tested against it, but the VisionClaw server does not depend on it
findings.consequence: codescape decodes against the published crate while the server encodes with its own code, and no test compares the two. A server-side wire change would not fail any check.

findings.title: Cross-repository path dependencies build against whatever sibling checkout is present
findings.consequence: Builds are not reproducible from one repository's pin. The pod-bridge lock records nostr-bbs-core beta.11 for a source that is beta.19 at the forum pin, and it holds two solid-pod-rs versions although Cargo.toml:70-73 says they are unified.

findings.title: Loom reads ontology scaffold bundles with ontomark-compile 0.1.1 while the corpus is built by ontomark 0.7.0
findings.consequence: Bundle compatibility is not checked anywhere. A bundle change in ontomark since 0.1.1 would surface as a grounding failure at the façade.

findings.title: Only one contract has a fixture shared by both sides; the rest are tested against hand-written copies
findings.consequence: F2 and F3 are both cases where a one-sided fixture passes while the real edge fails. The NIP-98 vector file is shared byte-for-byte but is only shape-checked on the agentbox side.

findings.title: GET /v1/status strips pid, which ApiStatus requires
findings.consequence: Container telemetry always reads as zero CPU and zero memory. The monitor degrades instead of failing.

findings.title: agentbox signs the NIP-98 u tag without the query string; the solid-pod-rs server verifies against the full URI
findings.consequence: Any agent-signed pod request that carries a query string fails authentication. Plain LDP writes to resource paths are unaffected.

findings.title: Agent-action envelope: failure_mode and authority_class are dropped by VisionClaw, and intent is never emitted
findings.consequence: MAST failure tags and authority classes do not survive the federation boundary, and the about-to line never renders. Already marked in ES-03.1; confirmed at the pins.

findings.title: Estate crate consumers lag their producers
findings.consequence: solid-pod-rs consumers sit at alpha.7 to alpha.17 against alpha.18; nostr-bbs-core consumers at beta.11 to beta.17 against beta.19; sidestr-core in the replay script at 0.4.0 against 0.4.2. Behavioural differences were not traced.

findings.title: The website builds two nostr-bbs-core versions, and its kit pin is 22 commits behind the forum
findings.consequence: The client built from source uses core beta.18 and the config crate uses beta.16. Whether they agree on shared types was not traced.

findings.title: The standalone WasmVOWL repository still pins the vowl-wasm v0.1.1 bundle
findings.consequence: A vowl-wasm release reaches the visionGraph explorer and not this one. ES-11.3 attributes the lag to knowledgeGraph only.

findings.title: VisionClaw's submodules lag the audit pins: agentbox by 51 commits, codescape by 6
findings.citation: VisionClaw:.gitmodules; gitlinks agentbox c3746299e923 and codescape e3b76f63e801 at 86cdd7635582
findings.consequence: Estate topics stamp VisionClaw and agentbox at separate pins, but VisionClaw compiles the older agentbox commit. schema/ is identical, so the federation artefact is safe; nothing else from the submodule was compared.

findings.title: The agentbox protocol registry still describes the pre-ADR-2061 kind-map asymmetry
findings.consequence: A reader is told that the Rust side refuses bead crossings. The translator now derives its map from the shared artefact.

findings.title: The legacy :9500 MCP-TCP poll has no producer in any pinned repository
findings.consequence: Either the edge is dead or its server lives outside the estate's pinned repositories. ES-02.7 to ES-02.9 draw it as LEGACY but do not say which.

findings.title: The strict-nip98 auto-elevation reads an env name the image never sets
findings.consequence: With sovereign_mesh enabled, the management API stays in hybrid mode and keeps accepting Bearer. That keeps VisionClaw's Bearer client working, but the hardening intent is dead config.

findings.title: The rationale gate's outcome set differs between the relay and the VisionClaw host
findings.consequence: A promote or demote decision on a high-tier case without a rationale is refused at the relay and accepted by the host path. An accept-spelled outcome is refused by the host and passed by the relay.

findings.title: Authority-denial agent events carry string ids where the canonical envelope needs integers
findings.consequence: Latent behind F1 and F2: once the forwarder sends canonical envelopes, every authority-denial event, the blocked-action beam, will still be rejected as Malformed by VisionClaw.
